C19.content_en:
Ways to see how Claude answers — and how the main tools compare

When a prospect asks Claude "what are good attendance-tracking tools for a small company?", does your name come up? You want to know before the sales call. Enter a question and this tool shows Claude's answer as text.

* You can now enter many items, one per line (each is sent one by one, so you pay per item). The table gets an "Input" column. Where the text below says "one", it describes a single item. See the table at the top for the cost.

Method / toolPricing modelNotes
This tool (DataForSEO)Pay per request. About $0.002 each (measured, no web search)Enter a question; get the answer text. Save as CSV. The model is fixed to claude-haiku-4-5
The Claude app (by hand)Free plan available (see the official site for limits)You ask and read. The real screen, so the most accurate. You keep your own record
Ahrefs Brand Radar (Prompt Tracking)Subscription (see the official site for prices and supported AI tools)Tracks chosen questions every day. For ongoing tracking
SE Ranking SE VisibleSubscription (see the official site for prices)Tracks exposure across several AI tools. Check the official site for which ones

Checked in November 2026. Prices change — confirm on each vendor's official site before you buy.

Why use this tool

  • Read the answer as text. See whether you or your rivals are named.
  • About $0.002 and a few seconds. Our New York ramen sample took 2.9 seconds and cost $0.0018. About 450 per $1, so you can try many questions.
  • Any question you like. Phrase it as a prospect would.
  • Save as CSV. Keep the answer with a date.
  • Headings and bullet lists display as written.

When it is not the right fit

  • You want fresh information or sources → this tool does not use web search. Claude answers from what it already knows and shows no sources (web search cost about $0.025 in our test).
  • You want exactly what the Claude app shows → this asks claude-haiku-4-5 through the API. The model and answer can differ from the app.
  • You want a verdict on whether you were named → the tool just lays out the answer.
  • You want ongoing tracking → one call is one answer at one moment.

This tool does one thing: show how Claude answers a question without web search.

FAQ

Why are there no sources?

The tool does not use web search. For sources, the Perplexity and Gemini tools fit better.

Does the cost depend on the answer length?

We measured about $0.002 (the US sample cost $0.0018; two earlier calls cost $0.0022 and $0.0024). The cost for a long answer is untested.

Why is there no country or language selector?

This call has no country or language setting.

Is the answer the same each time?

Answers can change from call to call.

Can I sign up with a free email address?

No. DataForSEO does not accept free email providers. See What is DataForSEO?

C20.content_en:
Ways to see how Gemini answers — and how the main tools compare

When someone asks Gemini about your client's industry, which sites does it cite? You want a line like "this is how AI search looks today" in your proposal. Enter a question and this tool returns Gemini's answer with web search, plus the pages it cited.

* You can now enter many items, one per line (each is sent one by one, so you pay per item). The table gets an "Input" column. Where the text below says "one", it describes a single item. See the table at the top for the cost.

Method / toolPricing modelNotes
This tool (DataForSEO)Pay per request. About $0.016–0.06 each (3 tests; average about $0.035)Enter a question; get the answer text and the cited pages (title and URL). Save as CSV. The model is fixed to gemini-3.5-flash-lite
The Gemini app (by hand)Free plan available (see the official site for limits)You ask and read. The real screen. You keep your own record
SE Ranking SE VisibleSubscription (see the official site for prices)Tracks exposure across several AI tools, Gemini included. For ongoing tracking
Ahrefs Brand RadarSubscription (see the official pricing page)Research and tracking of AI exposure

Checked in November 2026. Prices change — confirm on each vendor's official site before you buy.

Why use this tool

  • The answer and its sources, side by side. Keep the cited titles and URLs as they are.
  • Real source URLs. You get the original page URL, not a Google redirect link.
  • A few seconds. We measured about 4–8 seconds (our New York sample took 4.5 seconds).
  • Any question you like. Phrase it for your client's industry.
  • Save as CSV. Paste it into a proposal draft.

When it is not the right fit

  • You need a fixed price → with web search the cost varies with answer length and searches. In 3 tests it was $0.016, $0.030 and $0.058 (the New York sample cost $0.030).
  • You want exactly what the Gemini app shows → this asks gemini-3.5-flash-lite through the API, so the answer can differ.
  • You call at a busy moment → the service behind DataForSEO sometimes returned a busy error (50301). The tool retries up to 3 times, then says it is busy (no charge in that case).
  • You want ongoing tracking → one call is one answer at one moment.

This tool does one thing: show how web-search Gemini answers a question and what it cites.

FAQ

Why does the cost vary?

With web search, the cost depends on the amount of searching and the answer length. We measured about $0.016 to $0.058.

Why is a source title just a site name?

Gemini often names a citation by its site. We show it as returned.

Am I charged when an error comes back?

For the busy error (50301) the cost was $0.

Why is there no country or language selector?

This call has no country or language setting.

Can I sign up with a free email address?

No. DataForSEO does not accept free email providers. See What is DataForSEO?
